sections.title: Scope and seven facts
sections.text:
F1 — Service and scenario: Read-only account-data-sharing readiness; no live service, payment initiation or launch. Owed owner: Digital co-owner, to be named by the bank sponsor
F2 — Institution role: Fictional Bank Alpha is the LFI/data provider; the fictional app is the data recipient. Actual role selection is owed. Owed owner: the bank sponsor / digital co-owner
F3 — Customer journey: A customer would permit account-summary display. Detailed segment, consent steps and exceptions are unspecified. Owed owner: Digital and consent/control owners
F4 — Data and actions: Synthetic lab only; no actual identifiers, balances, credentials, consent grants or bank endpoints. Real data boundary and retention are owed. Owed owner: Digital and data-handling owners
F5 — Parties and interfaces: Fictional bank and one fictional third-party app. No real counterparty or live interface evidence is supplied. Owed owner: Digital / technology owners
F6 — Platform inheritance: No bank control is accepted as inherited. Applicable controls, policy releases, custodians and accepted evidence are unknown. Owed owner: Named control owner and evidence custodian
F7 — Decision and ownership: Identify readiness gaps, owners and next actions. The governing process, reviewer and later decision authority remain unconfirmed. Owed owner: the bank sponsor coordinates; accountable bank owners decide
